# CROSS-PLATFORM NOTE: flashPCA's eigenVECTORS are NOT cross-platform reproducible on this
# data and are deliberately NOT value-compared. The 20 eigenvalues are near-degenerate
# (all in [1.13, 1.58], ~2% consecutive gaps), so the eigenvectors are numerically
# ill-determined — a tiny macOS-vs-Linux OpenBLAS rounding difference rotates and
# sign-flips them (verified on CI: ~30% mean-rel-diff on vectors/loadings/projection with
# full sign flips on PC9/11/14, WHILE the eigenvalues matched to < 1e-6). So test_pca_flashpca
# pins the eigenVALUES (the well-determined invariant) + asserts eigenvector SHAPES only.

column5: flashpca step: 20 eigenvalues + pve (values only, not vectors — see note above). rtol=1e-5 absorbs cross-arch float drift.
